PerfTest-Suite: measures the fabric independently

I built the orchestration and evidence capture around the linux-rdma/perftest InfiniBand verbs microbenchmarks, run here over RoCEv2.

Send

Deliver a message into a receive buffer posted by the peer.

RDMA write

Push bytes directly into the peer's registered memory.

RDMA read

Pull bytes directly from the peer's registered memory.

Isolated: one logical device at a time.

Concurrent: four clients launched together; verify successful overlap.

9 / 18

Historical NCCL measurements compare sockets and RoCEv2

At 1 GiB, NCCL bus bandwidth: TCP sockets, all-reduce 2.12 GB/s and send/receive 3.05 GB/s; RoCEv2, all-reduce 21.18 GB/s and send/receive 24.09 GB/s.

Socket transport uses TCP/IP. RoCEv2 uses RDMA verbs over UDP/IP on Ethernet.

Historical measurements use different configurations and software revisions. A controlled comparison is required to quantify the transport contribution.
